questions.question: How did the style of teaching at your host institution compare with that of UCPH? *
questions.answer:
Similar. More flexible in some points - everything is live streamed and available to watch over. 
Little bit less practicals and more do it yourself.

questions.answer: Small language barriers, but they were nice and easy to understand when explained

questions.question: What parts of the culture did you most appreciate? *
questions.answer: Kindness, Openness and happiness

questions.question: What are the three most important things you would tell a UCPH student who is going to your host institution on exchange? *
questions.answer:
1. Have good saving or look for a job as soon as possible.
Australia is an expensive country to discover, so be prepared for that
2. Look into course descriptions - every course have nice descriptions, so read them before you choose.
3. Be opening meet new people.

questions.question: Is there any other information that you think might prove useful to future exchange students attending your host institution? *
questions.answer: Orientation week is not necessary, but a nice way to meet new people

questions.question: What was the most rewarding part of your exchange experience? *
questions.answer: Experiences and meeting so many new people from all over the world

questions.question: What was the greatest challenge during the exchange? *
questions.answer: having to socialize so often, due to the high amount of new people.
